result.instructions: Tools for Price2Spy, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which competitors sell my best-selling products for less than my target price?"; "Show the price history of the competitor URL for SKU ABC-123 over the last 30 days."; "List the products whose competitor price changed in the last 24 hours.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Price2Spy data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run price2spy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run price2spy_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run price2spy_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. price2spy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: price2spy_get_products
tools.title: Get products
tools.description: List the products tracked in Price2Spy with their brand, category, supplier, SKU, target price, cost price and lowest and highest competitor price. Filter by name, SKU, brand, category, supplier or price-change date. Uses POST /v1/get-products.

date_change_from.description: Only products whose price changed on or after this time. UTC, in the same format as dateChecked in the responses (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss).

date_change_to.description: Only products whose price changed on or before this time. UTC, in the same format as dateChecked in the responses (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss).

search_mode.description: LIKE matches part of a text filter; EQUAL needs the exact value.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, max 500).

tools.name: price2spy_get_current_pricing_data
tools.title: Get current pricing data
tools.description: Get the latest competitor prices: each matching product with every monitored URL, its shop name, last price, stock and the time of the check. Use this to compare your price with competitors. Uses POST /v1/get-current-pricing-data. Large accounts return a lot of data, so filter and keep limit low.

date_change_from.description: Only products whose price changed on or after this time. UTC, in the same format as dateChecked in the responses (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss).

date_change_to.description: Only products whose price changed on or before this time. UTC, in the same format as dateChecked in the responses (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss).

search_mode.description: LIKE matches part of a text filter; EQUAL needs the exact value.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, max 500).

tools.name: price2spy_get_urls
tools.title: Get monitored URLs
tools.description: List monitored product page URLs with the shop name, country, last check time, last error, and the last two price measurements. Search by product id, SKU, internal id or name. Uses POST /v1/get-urls.

id.description: The value to search for: a product id, SKU, internal id or name, as set by id_mode.

search_mode.description: LIKE matches part of a text filter; EQUAL needs the exact value.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, max 500).

tools.name: price2spy_get_measurements
tools.title: Get price history of a URL
tools.description: Get the price history of one monitored URL: each measurement with price, currency, stock status, seller, shipping cost and promotion. Get the url_id from price2spy_get_urls. Uses POST /v1/get-measurements.

date_checked_from.description: Only measurements on or after this time. UTC, in the same format as dateChecked in the responses (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss).

date_checked_to.description: Only measurements on or before this time. UTC, in the same format as dateChecked in the responses (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, max 500).
